name: Short Cut Veggie "Bacon", Avocado & "Everything" Salad Wrap

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Once hot, coat with nonstick cooking spray and add veggie bacon strips. Cook, turning halfway through, until crisp, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 spritz nonstick cooking spray
8 strip plant-based bacon

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place contents of the salad kit in a medium bowl, including dressing and topping packets. Toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 (328 g) pkg everything chopped salad kit

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, halve, and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and slice crosswise into thin half-moons.
Arrange tortillas on a flat surface, then divide avocado, bacon, and salad between them. Roll tortillas tightly to close and cut in half.
To serve, divide wraps between plates and enjoy!
